preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the permutation n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The sum of n over all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output -1; otherwise, output n distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all((int(p) + i) ** 0.5 == int((int(p) + i) ** 0.5) for i, p in enumerate(stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: For each index i, the value p_i + i must be a perfect square.
